Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and indication label 'hypertension'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
